title: parley run bootstrap
description: First line of stdout, emitted before work begins so a crashed run still names its receipt.

seq.description: The bootstrap line is always the first line the run emits, so it is the only line with a pinned seq.

v.description: The program's own version, distinct from any schema version.

inv.description: Content-addressed identity of the question: tool, version, normalised args, and the bytes of every declared input.

run.description: Unique, lexicographically sortable identity of this execution.

session.description: Working period spanning runs. Supplied by the caller or inherited.

version.description: Any 1.x.y: a reader validates every line of the major it was built against and ignores fields it does not know (spec §4.5).
